title: My wife pays thousands of dollars for her family to visit from Argentina. How can I convince her to stop?
html:
The Moneyist

My wife pays thousands of dollars for her family to visit from Argentina. How can I convince her to stop?

‘I don’t want my wife to feel that I’m asking her to choose between me and her family’

Dear Quentin,

My wife and I have a wonderful marriage, but there is one recurring issue that has become a significant source of frustration for me. While my wife is an exceptionally generous and giving person, I feel that some of her family members have come to take advantage of that generosity.

Several of her relatives regularly want to visit us in New York, traveling from Argentina. Given the long journey, these visits typically last around two weeks. Some of her nieces, nephews and siblings expect to visit virtually every year.
summary: “I don’t want my wife to feel that I’m asking her to choose between me and her family.”
